sourceAttempts.result: NFCT documents the Rabion Farm–Lane Road half-day paddle, quickwater and a short Class II rapid, and instructs paddlers to look for the Troy gauge above 180 cfs.
UMATR publishes Lowell VT 100, Lane Road and River Road access coordinates; River Road is explicitly above a dam and is a mandatory take-out.
USGS 04293000 provides direct Missisquoi discharge and gage-height telemetry near North Troy.
All three route-scoped traces follow the named Missisquoi channel and the coordinate audits returned two OK endpoints per route.

thresholdEvidence.reachApplicability: NFCT's 180 cfs floor is tied to the Troy gauge for the upper Missisquoi paddle; the same conservative floor is used for these adjacent access combinations. Verify trend, wood, channel changes and the River Road dam boundary before travel.

validation: Route-data audit passed for 2,265 routes; the three routes are scored and public-indexed.
Full scored safety audit returned 0 issues across 1,208 scored routes.
Canonical geometry audit passed for 2,151 of 2,164 public-indexed routes with 48 state assets; all three Missisquoi traces are present and endpoint-bounded.
Production build passed after the Vermont extension; 2,568 static pages generated with route/runtime/workspace/mobile checks, route-data and geometry audits.
The three Missisquoi routes were included in the public catalog and direct-gauge scored population.
pending: Complete browser verification and recheck current NFCT/UMATR access notes, 04293000 trend, wood, changing channels and the River Road dam boundary before deployment.
